description: This Java source file implements the DeviceRegistrationWritePlatformService interface, providing functionality for registering, updating, and deleting device registration records within the Fineract platform. It handles data integrity issues during registration and manages device registration entities in relation to clients.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing device registration management, including registration, update, and deletion, with data integrity handling.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a device for a client, handling potential data integrity issues such as duplicate registration IDs.

methods.name: updateDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Updates device registration details for an existing device record.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity violations during device registration, throwing appropriate exceptions based on the cause.
